notes: Issue concerns chained exception serialization across pytest-xdist workers.
No xdist-compatible worker/runtime or wire-serialization experiment is authored in this block. A local pretty traceback alone would not reproduce the reported failure.

limitations: No human verdicts are provided or inferred.
Selected pytest examples are executed inside candidate containers; host compares emitted observations.
Pinned dependencies enable historical source layouts; no repository setup or candidate import runs on the host.
--assert=plain and disabled plugin autoload avoid unrelated runtime/third-party behavior; probes do not establish complete task correctness.
Fresh checkouts lack setuptools-scm generated _pytest._version. Adapter supplies only explicit 0.0.0/tuple metadata in memory; no source file, setup step, or behavioral fix is added.
